relevance_note: The paper describes three unrelated patients with novel TNFAIP3 loss-of-function variants and a lupus nephritis/HA20 phenotype individually ("Three biopsy-proven LN patients with TNFAIP3 loss-of-function mutations were studied."), plus relatives.
method_note: Read extract_v6, schema_ha20_v5.json and extraction_rules_v1.md; only the paper, those files and my scratch dir were used. I read the whole Markdown (Tables 1-5 and the text) by hand and wrote the JSON by hand; no script transcribed any table. Every span was checked to occur verbatim in the paper. Tables with patients as columns: Table 1 '| Characteristics | Patient 1 | Patient 2 | Patient 3 |', Table 2 '| Findings | Patient 1 | Patient 2 | Patient 3 |', Table 3 '| Characteristics | Patient 1 | Patient 2 | Patient 3 |'; Table 4 has patients as rows. Column spans quote the row label through that patient's cell. No cell used the ' / ' stacked-value separator, so D-31 (v6) did not apply. Table 1 'No' cells (recurrent fever, serositis, musculoskeletal, ocular, cardiovascular) are the English word for absence, not an undefined symbol, so they were recorded as 'excluded'; the legends define only AIHA and ILD. Loose/contradictory statements: the Discussion sentence 'They shared some clinical hallmarks with auto-inflammatory phenotype of HA20 [1, 2, 15], including recurrent oral ulcers, intermittent fever, hepatosplenomegaly, skin lesions, arthralgia or arthritis and elevated pro-inflammatory markers.' conflicts with Table 1 for P1 (recurrent fever 'No') and P2 (musculoskeletal 'No') and names no individual, so it was not used as per-person evidence. P2's 'without any autoantibodies' at 10 months vs later positive ANA is temporal evolution, not a contradiction. P3's 'During follow-up, she had no fever or proteinuria' is treatment response, not a contradiction with her onset fever. Judgements: P2's parents are included as tested-negative relatives ('as neither parent harboured the variant') but are described only as a pair, so the labels are 'parent of P2' and 'parent of P2 2' in mention order. The variant rows for P1's and P3's mothers rest on '| Mutation origin | From mother' and 'Her asymptomatic mother had the same mutation confirmed by Sanger sequencing'. The two patients from earlier reports in the Discussion (p.Q187*, p.F224Sfs*4) are included per the v4 scope rule, with source_reference_in_review '[2, 19]'. pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors 'loss-of-function' comes from the title statement about the three variants, one per patient. age_at_diagnosis uses 'Age at LN diagnosis'; the same table also prints genetic diagnosis ages (35, 3.5, 3). Checklist mapping: P1's dry eyes were not mapped to 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation'; P2's 'vasculitic rashes' were mapped to vasculitis; P3's 'Bilateral knee effusion' was not mapped to arthritis/arthralgia; the son of P1's 'anaemia' was not mapped to autoimmune cytopenia; P3's mother's 'asymptomatic' excludes no specific feature. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients=false has span null, since no quote can support that negative.
